title: AdaptiveObserverCache: persistent observer state changes how frozen memory is read
summary: AdaptiveObserverCache turns the observer-in-the-loop motif into an executable transformer mechanism. Instead of rewriting weights or old K/V, it keeps a slow persistent observer state outside the frozen memory and lets that state change the query/read geometry. Gate 2 demonstrates the mechanism on real DistilGPT2 K/V; Gate 3 shows the first reusable coordinate was positional rather than identity-based; Gates 4–6 factor persistent provenance from current address and surface alias; Gate 7 removes the terminal alias edge and uses historical behavioral evidence plus current measurements to infer continuity. The project therefore moves from 'steer one attention head' toward a persistent epistemic control layer: what was learned earlier changes how unchanged history is interrogated now. The Anthropic J-space/Jacobian-lens work is a close conceptual neighbor but not a lineage edge: J-space identifies and causally writes verbalizable residual-stream workspace directions within a forward pass, while AdaptiveObserverCache adds explicit state across reads and acts primarily on memory addressing/query policy.

nodes.claim: Tests whether a frozen transformer can carry a persistent observer state outside the prompt/KV so that earlier calibration, provenance and historical evidence change how the same stored history is queried later, without rewriting weights or old K/V.
nodes.survived: Gate 2 uses real DistilGPT2 projected K/V and gets 1.000 blind retrieval accuracy versus 0.500 for best-fixed and reset-observer controls while K/V remains byte-stable. Gate 3 shows the reusable coordinate transfers across content/wording but initially tracks source slot rather than identity. Gates 4–6 separate persistent provenance from current slot and alias continuity. Gate 7 removes the terminal alias relation: history + current measurements + persistent trust restores current identity at 1.000 accuracy across 24 identity-conditioned reads, while static slot and reset history are 0.500 and shuffled history is 0.000.
nodes.killed: The first pretrained observer was cache-specific; Gate 3 killed the stronger identity interpretation by failing both order-swapped prompts. Later gates require explicit symbolic binding/alias structure, and Gate 7 still uses a designed probe/fingerprint space. The repository has not yet shown open-ended semantic re-identification, cheaper active sensing, robust long-chat Qwen/RoPE integration, or improved free-form generation.

edges.why: AinsteinInside's Gate 0.7d made the measuring apparatus itself a live variable when harmless execution geometry changed tiny causal conclusions. AdaptiveObserverCache turns that methodological lesson into a mechanism: observer state is explicit and changes how frozen transformer memory is read.

OperatorTime established the abstract form that resident history can change the effective operator available now even when parameters stay fixed. AdaptiveObserverCache instantiates that idea as a persistent reader state that changes the effective attention/query operator over unchanged memory.

ReadWrite shows that what is knowable depends on the probe/intervention rather than on passive state alone. AdaptiveObserverCache moves that bounded-observer idea inside transformer memory: the current query geometry determines which distinction in frozen K/V becomes visible.

WhatToLookAt makes remembered relations change which later measurement is worth buying. AdaptiveObserverCache Gate 7 reaches the same boundary from transformer memory: history constrains current identity, and the next planned gate explicitly prices which probe the observer should purchase.

PredictiveHKT warns that changing representation coordinates can impersonate world/operator change. AdaptiveObserverCache's identity/alias gates separate durable provenance from its current surface key/address, making coordinate translation an explicit part of memory reuse.

AuditedEpistemicCache records provenance and representation-generation receipts so old evidence is not blindly reused. AdaptiveObserverCache turns that bookkeeping principle into a read operation: old trust/history is rebound to the current representation before it may control retrieval.

AInstein's provenance-misbinding controls show that having the right ingredients with the wrong addresses can yield confident failure. AdaptiveObserverCache makes source identity/address binding a first-class operation before attention is steered.
